title: Dockerfiles missing uv.lock COPY — all Docker builds fail
description: All 7 Dockerfiles run 'uv sync --frozen' which requires a uv.lock file, but none of the Dockerfiles include a COPY instruction for uv.lock. Docker builds fail immediately. This is a systematic error: every Dockerfile generated by the Infrastructure Architect sub-agent has the same missing COPY line.
root_cause: Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B (Infrastructure Architect) generates Dockerfiles with COPY pyproject.toml and RUN uv sync --frozen, but the prompt does not mention that uv.lock must also be copied into the container. The sub-agent's Dockerfile template lacks awareness of UV workspace lockfile requirements.
recommendation: In Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B's prompt for Dockerfile generation, add explicit instruction: 'For UV workspace projects, the Dockerfile must COPY both pyproject.toml AND uv.lock before running uv sync --frozen. The lockfile is at the workspace root.' Also add to the Reconciliation step (Phase 3.4): verify that each Dockerfile's COPY instructions include all files referenced by the build commands.
affected_phase: Phase 3.2 — Sub-Agent Path: Infrastructure Architect (Docker section)
